summary: Tested offline-first migration flow and 'Recover Old Notes from Server' feature. Core functionality works: (1) Fresh load auto-migrates 4 backend notes into IndexedDB and displays them; (2) Migration flag 'migrated_from_backend' is set correctly preventing repeat auto-migration; (3) Settings modal renders 'Recover Old Notes from Server' button (data-testid='restore-server-btn'); (4) Manual restore fetches from backend and merges without duplicates (notesCount stays 4 -> 4). Two minor UX issues identified around toast messaging.

ui_bugs.issue: Because index.js wraps App in <React.StrictMode>, useEffect runs twice on mount in dev. Both invocations enter migrateFromBackend() before the 'migrated_from_backend' flag is set (race condition). First call migrates 4 notes and returns notes:4; the second call sees existingIds already populated and returns notes:0 but still migrated:true. Result: user sees a confusing 'Restored 0 notes from server' success toast even though the migration actually restored their notes correctly. Reproduced consistently on preview URL. (In production build StrictMode is inert, so this only manifests in dev/preview, but the underlying race condition remains and is not idempotent-safe.)
ui_bugs.selector: toast in top-right after fresh IDB load

ui_bugs.issue: When user clicks 'Recover Old Notes from Server' and all notes already exist locally, the toast shows 'Restored 0 notes and 0 templates from server' as a SUCCESS toast. This is misleading - user expects either the restored count or a message like 'No additional notes to restore'. The else branch ('No additional notes found on server') is unreachable when force=true because migrated is always true in that case.

passed_tests: Fresh page load with cleared IndexedDB triggers automatic migration - all 4 backend notes (Test #4, Test Backend Note, Test Reminder Note, Test Note) appear on the main screen
IndexedDB metadata store correctly persists 'migrated_from_backend' = true after first migration
Notes count reads 4 in IDB after migration (verified via evaluate on indexedDB)
Settings modal includes 'Recover Old Notes from Server' button with data-testid='restore-server-btn' and Cloud icon
Manual restore button click triggers migration with force=true and fetches from backend
Manual restore shows 'Checking server for your notes...' info toast during operation
Manual restore shows a success toast (count included in text)
Manual restore does NOT create duplicate notes when all notes already exist (notesCount stayed at 4 before and after click)
Backend /api/notes returns 4 test notes as expected
action_items: Fix StrictMode/race condition in fetchData migration: either (a) use a ref/guard to ensure migrateFromBackend only runs once per mount, or (b) set the migrated_from_backend flag BEFORE performing the fetch/insertion so the second concurrent call short-circuits, or (c) only show the success toast when migration.notes > 0.

Improve manual restore UX: in handleRestoreFromServer, if result.migrated && result.notes === 0 && result.templates === 0, show 'No additional notes to restore' (info) instead of a success toast with '0 notes'.
critical_code_review_comments: storageService.js migrateFromBackend is not concurrency-safe: two parallel calls both pass the alreadyMigrated check, both fetch from backend, and both write to IndexedDB. Set the flag first (or wrap in a promise-cache) to make it idempotent.
In App.js fetchData: toast.success is fired whenever migration.migrated is true, regardless of whether any note was actually restored. Should gate on migration.notes > 0.

fetchData is used as a callback dependency and also triggers on every notes change indirectly via other flows - consider extracting the one-time migration into a separate useEffect that runs strictly once (with a mounted-ref guard) instead of coupling it with the general data loader.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Used existing 4 notes on backend at /api/notes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The migration + restore-from-server feature is functionally working (notes migrate, no duplicates, correct persistence). Only cosmetic toast messaging issues remain. Backend has 4 test notes at /api/notes on https://color-task-timer.preview.emergentagent.com. To reset IndexedDB use page.evaluate with indexedDB.deleteDatabase('IronRabbit'). Header settings button is the 4th (last) button in <header>. Wait for toasts to clear (~4s) before clicking settings button as toast overlay can intercept clicks.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the 'Restored 0 notes' spurious toast: React.StrictMode in index.js causes useEffect (which calls fetchData) to run twice in dev. Both invocations start migrateFromBackend simultaneously. The check 'if (alreadyMigrated && !force) return {migrated:false}' passes in both because neither has yet set the metadata flag. Both proceed. First one inserts 4 notes; second sees existingIds populated and returns {migrated:true, notes:0}. Fix options: (1) guard fetchData with a useRef flag; (2) atomically set 'migrated_from_backend' at the START of migrateFromBackend before doing IO; (3) only toast when migration.notes > 0.
